# EMATS (EMATS TECHNOLOGY SALES AND SERVICE)

> ECU repair in Johor Bahru for car workshops: component-level repair of ECU/ECM, ABS modules and instrument clusters. Diagnosis before quote. Send-in service.

- Registration: RA0076024-T
- Location: Johor Bahru, Malaysia
- Customers: mainly car workshops (send-in service); car owners also welcome
- How it works: diagnosis before quote; repair, not replace
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/kam.jackie.52
